en: The postcard features a monochromatic photograph in green tones, depicting a large and ancient linden tree (lime tree) with wide-spreading branches and a circular bench surrounding its trunk. The tree stands on a slight elevation with a curved path leading up to it, flanked by two other trees. The text on the front reads 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Alte Linde auf dem Schloßwall,' suggesting it shows a notable local tree 'Old Linden on the Castle Wall.' The reverse side contains a museum stamp 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT,' publisher information, and space for correspondence and an address.
